alignments.note: Substantival ὁ δέ; the article supplies the pronoun he (rules 14, 22).
Participle converted to a coordinate finite clause; the juncture and goes to the verb it introduces under rule 88.
Rule 88 juncture with the finite verb; head on the lexical verb.
Determinerless English, so the case preposition stays with the pronoun (rule 21).
Subject of the genitive absolute → the predicate noun evening.
Supplied subordinator When on a participle is a rule 86 helper; the expletive it and the copula ride with the participle that carries the clause.
Inflected verb with its English subject; head on the lexical verb (rule 9).

Verbless clause with no expressed subject, so the predicate noun carries the supplied subject and copula (rule 68); εὐδία is a compound whose core element is the weather word, so rule 66 heads there rather than on fair.
πυρράζω rendered copula plus adjective; rule 17 heads on the meaning-bearing complement red rather than the copula.
